chunks: (The messengers) said: "Our Lord knows that we have been sent to you."
ai.seo_question: What did the prophets say to prove their divine mission in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In this verse, the prophets affirm that their mission is verified by Allah’s omniscience, a key argument in Surah Yaseen used to counter the skepticism of their contemporaries. Shia exegesis highlights this as a demonstration of divine backing (tawqif) for the messengers, reinforcing the legitimacy of their authority against those who doubted their status.
